extracted.intended_audience: YouTube creators, publishers, newsrooms, and journalists producing video news content
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and ranking criteria for how YouTube's recommendation system evaluates and surfaces news-related videos across homepage, suggested/watch-next, and search. Useful for creators and newsrooms seeking to make videos more discoverable and appropriately surfaced for sensitive/ breaking topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core algorithm question
rubrics_metrics.description: "Will this specific viewer enjoy this specific video right now?"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The algorithm predicts per-viewer enjoyment via machine learning on billions of signals per second; this predictive objective drives ranking across surfaces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the three main ranking factors — measures how well the video matches the user's query or current interest (applies strongly in search and suggested surfaces).

rubrics_metrics.name: Engagement (ranking category)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key ranking factor: signals such as watch time, completion rate, and viewer interactions (likes, comments, shares) indicate engagement and influence recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality (authority signals)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A main ranking factor: authority and perceived content quality boost ranking, particularly for sensitive topics (news/medical/political).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information quality / Source-reliability assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: News, medical, political videos: special source-reliability assessment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: YouTube uses special vetting for health, science, and breaking news; vetted publishers and subject-matter experts receive boosts; authority is required for sensitive topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Channel authority for news topics
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Channel-level reputation and demonstrated expertise on news topics influence search rankings and recommendations; vetted/publisher channels are prioritized for certain queries and shelves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Breaking News Shelf eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Appears on homepage during major breaking events; features relevant videos on a specific topic
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surfaces during disasters, attacks, and major political events to surface topical videos quickly; eligibility depends on topical relevance and event status.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Search Results / News shelf prioritization
rubrics_metrics.description: "News shelf" appears near top of relevant queries; pulls from "high quality sources"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search results promote a News shelf for relevant queries and prioritize vetted publishers and high-quality sources for news-related queries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trending criterion: sharp influx of views
rubrics_metrics.description: Sharp influx of views over short period
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historically used to identify trending videos (pre-2025); signals rapid attention spikes that can trigger elevated visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trending criterion: regional popularity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regional spikes or local popularity influence trend detection and localized surfacing for users in affected areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trending criterion: high audience engagement in short period
rubrics_metrics.description: High audience engagement in short period
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rapid, concentrated engagement (comments, likes, shares, watch time) within a short window contributes to trend signals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trending criterion: diversity of viewers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broad and diverse viewer base (not just a single niche) was a factor in prior trending logic and influences how widely a trend is surfaced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Watch time potential
rubrics_metrics.description: Watch time potential — long enough hooks
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Videos that can retain viewers and generate longer watch time are favored; creators should craft hooks and pacing to maximize retention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Click-through rate prediction (CTR)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Thumbnails and titles are evaluated for predicted CTR; effective creative assets increase the chance the algorithm predicts a user will click.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completion rate
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fraction of viewers who watch a video to the end informs ranking via engagement/retention signals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engagement metrics (likes, comments, shares)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interactions beyond watch time (social actions, comments) are measured and contribute to ranking and trend-detection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video quality (production)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Production values and overall presentation quality are considered signals of quality and can improve discoverability, especially for authoritative news content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency of topic (timeliness)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timeliness matters — breaking and current topics are more likely to be surfaced, particularly in shelves and during major events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personalization fit
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How well a video matches an individual user's history and interests strongly affects whether it is recommended to that viewer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommendation area: Homepage ranking factors
rubrics_metrics.description: Homepage — Performance factors + previous watch history; Personalized
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Homepage recommendations weigh video performance signals together with the viewer's prior watch history to personalize the surface.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommendation area: Suggested (Watch Next) ranking factors
rubrics_metrics.description: Suggested (Watch Next) — Watch history; Broader viewer trends; Current video topic relevance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The watch-next surface uses the viewer's watch history, broader viewer behavior trends, and topic relevance to decide what to recommend next.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommendation area: Search ranking signals
rubrics_metrics.description: Search — Query relevance; Channel authority; Engagement signals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search ranking combines relevance to the query with channel authority and engagement signals; news-specific shelves further prioritize vetted sources.
